text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is a very prestigious race, and Trainer looks incredibly nervous right now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Maybe if we had met after I was a bit more grown up, Trainer wouldn't always be so worried for me…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wonder why we had to meet now, of all times…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No. This isn't the time. I have to focus on the race. Trainer believes in me and said I'll be fine. So I just have to run for Trainer's sake!
